title: Pope Leo XIV Continues Steady Recovery After Lung Surgery
subtitle: Doctors confirm the pontiff is making good progress following a successful operation to remove a cancerous growth.

summary.en: Pope Leo XIV is recovering well in a Rome hospital following a successful operation to remove part of his right lung. Surgeons performed a lobectomy to treat a cancerous growth known as adenocarcinoma. The Vatican reports that the 71-year-old leader is already moving around, which is a positive sign for his health. Doctors used a video-assisted keyhole technique to minimize pain and speed up the healing process. Further medical tests will determine if any additional treatment is necessary in the coming weeks.
summary.zh: 教宗利奧十四世在接受切除部分右肺的成功手術後，目前於羅馬的醫院康復狀況良好。外科醫師透過肺葉切除術治療了名為肺腺癌的腫瘤。梵蒂岡表示，這位七十一歲的領袖已經可以下床活動，這是健康狀況良好的正面跡象。醫師採用了影像輔助微創技術，以減輕疼痛並加速癒合過程。後續的醫療檢測將決定未來幾週是否需要進行額外的治療。

paragraphs.en: Pope Leo XIV continues to make steady progress in a Rome hospital following his surgery earlier this week. The 71-year-old leader underwent a procedure to remove a section of his right lung after a routine health check revealed a small growth. According to The Guardian, doctors confirmed the growth was a type of lung cancer called adenocarcinoma, which is the most common form of the disease in people who have never smoked.
paragraphs.zh: 教宗利奧十四世（Pope Leo XIV）本週稍早接受手術後，目前在羅馬的一家醫院持續穩定康復中。這位七十一歲的領袖因例行健康檢查發現一處小腫塊，隨後接受了切除部分右肺的手術。根據《衛報》（The Guardian）報導，醫師證實該腫塊為肺腺癌，這是從未吸菸者中最常見的肺癌類型。

paragraphs.en: This latest update comes after the Vatican reported that the Pope had a successful second night following the operation. The surgery, known as a lobectomy, involved removing one of the five sections of the lung. By taking out the entire section containing the tumor, surgeons aimed to remove all cancer cells while leaving enough healthy tissue for the Pope to live an active life. The Guardian noted that the remaining parts of the lung will adapt over time to support his breathing.
paragraphs.zh: 這項最新消息是在梵蒂岡宣布教宗術後第二晚狀況良好之後發布的。這項稱為肺葉切除術的手術，內容是切除肺部五個部分中的其中之一。外科醫師透過移除包含腫瘤的整個肺葉，旨在清除所有癌細胞，同時保留足夠的健康組織，以確保教宗能維持活躍的生活。據《衛報》指出，剩餘的肺部組織將會隨時間適應，以維持他的呼吸功能。

paragraphs.en: To ensure the surgery was as safe and effective as possible, the medical team used a video-assisted technique. This is a common form of keyhole surgery, which uses a camera and small cuts rather than a large opening. This method is generally preferred because it leads to less pain, smaller scars, and a faster recovery compared to traditional open surgery. During the procedure, doctors also checked nearby lymph nodes—small glands that help the body fight infection—to see if the cancer had spread. The Vatican has not yet shared the results of those specific tests.
paragraphs.zh: 為了確保手術盡可能安全且有效，醫療團隊採用了影像輔助技術。這是一種常見的微創手術，利用攝影機與小切口取代傳統的大型開刀。相較於傳統開放式手術，這種方法通常較受青睞，因為它能減少疼痛、縮小疤痕並加快復原速度。手術過程中，醫師也檢查了附近的淋巴結（即協助身體對抗感染的小腺體），以確認癌症是否擴散。梵蒂岡尚未公布這些特定檢查的結果。

paragraphs.en: One of the reasons for the quick diagnosis was a technique called a frozen section. While the Pope was still under anesthesia, doctors took a sample of the lung tissue and quickly froze and examined it under a microscope. This allowed the medical team to confirm the cancer diagnosis within minutes and decide exactly how much lung tissue needed to be removed. This process is highly effective for ensuring that surgeons do not remove more healthy tissue than is necessary.
paragraphs.zh: 能快速診斷的原因之一是採用了「冷凍切片」技術。在教宗仍處於麻醉狀態時，醫師取出一塊肺組織樣本，並迅速冷凍後在顯微鏡下進行檢查。這讓醫療團隊能在幾分鐘內確認癌症診斷，並精確決定需要切除多少肺組織。此過程對於確保外科醫師不會切除過多不必要的健康組織非常有效。

paragraphs.en: Following the surgery, the Pope has already begun the process of getting back on his feet. Medical staff helped him out of bed just one day after the operation. Moving early is a standard part of recovery, as it helps lower the risk of chest infections and blood clots. A tube, known as a chest drain, remains in place to help air and fluid escape while the lung heals. The Vatican expects the pontiff to remain in the hospital for about a week to ensure he is stable.
paragraphs.zh: 手術後，教宗已經開始進行恢復活動的過程。醫療人員在術後僅一天就協助他下床。儘早活動是復原過程中的標準程序，因為這有助於降低胸腔感染與血栓的風險。目前體內仍留有一根稱為胸腔引流管的管子，用以在肺部癒合期間協助排出空氣與體液。梵蒂岡預計教宗將在醫院停留約一週，以確保狀況穩定。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, the final pathology report will be the most important factor in deciding the next steps for his health. Adenocarcinoma is often tested for specific genetic changes that certain modern drugs can target. If the tests show that the cancer has not spread, surgery alone can sometimes be enough to cure the patient. However, if the results suggest a higher risk, doctors may recommend additional treatments to keep him healthy.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，最終的病理報告將是決定他後續健康計畫最重要的因素。肺腺癌通常會進行特定基因變異檢測，以確認是否能使用某些現代藥物進行標靶治療。如果檢測顯示癌症未擴散，有時僅靠手術即可治癒患者。然而，若結果顯示風險較高，醫師可能會建議採取額外的治療方式以維持他的健康。

paragraphs.en: While the news of the Pope’s illness has been a subject of international concern, the reports from his medical team remain positive. The focus now is on his continued rest and physical recovery. As he heals, the Vatican will likely provide more updates on his ability to return to his official duties. For now, the medical team is satisfied with his progress, noting that his recovery is following a normal and healthy path.
paragraphs.zh: 雖然教宗患病的消息引起國際關注，但醫療團隊的報告依然正面。目前的重點在於讓他持續休息並恢復體力。隨著他逐漸康復，梵蒂岡可能會針對他何時能重返公務提供更多消息。目前醫療團隊對他的進展感到滿意，並指出他的復原狀況正循著正常且健康的軌道進行。

keyTerms.definitionEn: An abnormal mass of tissue, such as a tumor.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作動詞（grow）的名詞形式，指成長，但在醫學語境下指體內異常增生的組織。文中：a routine health check revealed a small growth.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To recover from an illness or injury and start being active again.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 恢復健康、重新站起來（指康復過程）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 字面上是「回到腳上」，但這裡指手術後的身體康復。文中：Following the surgery, the Pope has already begun the process of getting back on his feet.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A course of action or a process of development.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見指實體的路徑，這裡比喻為康復的進程。文中：noting that his recovery is following a normal and healthy path.

quiz.question: What was the primary purpose of using the 'frozen section' technique during the Pope's surgery?

options.A: To minimize the size of the scars left on the patient's body.
options.B: To determine the exact amount of lung tissue that required removal.
options.C: To check if the cancer had spread to the nearby lymph nodes.
options.D: To prevent the patient from experiencing chest infections after the procedure.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據第四段，使用冷凍切片技術（frozen section）的主要目的是為了在手術中快速診斷，並以此決定需要切除多少肺部組織，以避免切除過多健康的組織。選項 A 是指微創手術（keyhole surgery）的優點；選項 C 是指檢查淋巴結的目的，而非冷凍切片的目的；選項 D 則是術後下床活動的好處，與冷凍切片無關。

quiz.question: Based on the information provided, what can be inferred about the future treatment of the Pope?

options.A: He will definitely require chemotherapy since he had a lobectomy.
options.B: His recovery is considered unusual because he is a non-smoker.
options.C: Additional treatments depend on the findings of the final pathology report.
options.D: The doctors have already confirmed that the cancer has not spread to other areas.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第六段，病理報告（pathology report）是決定後續治療步驟最重要的因素，若報告顯示風險較高，醫生才會建議額外治療。選項 A 錯誤，因為手術本身有時就足以治癒；選項 B 與文章內容矛盾，文章提到他是非吸菸者，但未稱其恢復過程不尋常；選項 D 錯誤，文章明確指出尚未分享淋巴結檢查結果，且病理報告尚未出爐。

quiz.question: In the fifth paragraph, what does the phrase 'getting back on his feet' mean in the context of the Pope's recovery?

options.A: He is learning to walk again after a long period of paralysis.
options.B: He is beginning to regain his strength and resume normal activities.
options.C: He is preparing to travel to another country for official duties.
options.D: He is standing up to give a public speech at the hospital.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。片語 'getting back on one's feet' 在此處指身體狀況好轉、恢復健康並能重新開始正常活動。選項 A 過度解讀，文章並未提到他曾癱瘓；選項 C 與文章提到的『恢復期』不符；選項 D 雖提到他下床，但這僅是復健的一環，並非指他要發表公開演說。

quiz.question: What is the primary focus of this article?

options.A: To explain the history and risks of adenocarcinoma in non-smokers.
options.B: To criticize the medical team's decision to perform a lobectomy on the Pope.
options.C: To provide a detailed medical guide on how to perform video-assisted lung surgery.
options.D: To report on the Pope's successful surgery and his current recovery progress.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。整篇文章的核心在於報導教宗手術後的狀況、醫療團隊採用的技術、目前的復原進度以及對未來的展望。選項 A 只是背景資訊的一部分；選項 B 與事實不符，文章語氣正面；選項 C 雖然介紹了手術技術，但該技術僅是報導中的細節，並非整篇文章的主旨。
